n16864.source: Plotinus, Enneades, ed. Richard Volkmann (First1K)

n16864.source: Herodotus, Historiae, ed. A. D. Godley, Cambridge 1920 (Perseus)

n16864.source: Herodotus, Historiae, ed. A. D. Godley, Cambridge 1920 (Perseus)

n16864.source: Plato, Phaedo, ed. John Burnet, Oxford 1905 (Perseus)
